capabilities: Create temporary notes that are deleted when you switch away from them
Create session notes that persist until Obsidian closes
Customize hotkeys for creating temporary and session notes
extras: Installed manually from GitHub releases by extracting files into the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to jot quick throwaway notes without leaving clutter that must be cleaned up manually.
summary: Ephemeral note creator that makes temporary notes deleted when you switch away and session notes wiped when Obsidian closes.
